subject: Renewal negotiation — volume commit add-on, price hold & prorated credits
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@orbiotech.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — capacity uplift request

Hi Karthik,

Were getting close to the end of our current 12-month term (ends 2027-06-30) and were looking to both renew and increase committed capacity for Q3/Q4. Usage has ramped faster than we forecasted; we expect approx 2.4x current spend on generation tokens and will need higher burst capacity during peak experiments.

Primary asks:
- Lock current per-token price for 6 months post-renewal (price hold) while we migrate more workloads
- Add a ~2x reserved commit band with a 3-month prorated start (wed like credits to cover partial-month overlap)
- A deliverable: MOP (runbook) for burst-onboarding + a small onboarding credit to offset trial costs

Can you share what flexibility we have on price hold + how Redwood would structure prorated credits on a mid-cycle commit increase? Were also open to a modest multi-quarter discount if we commit to the larger band.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director of ML Infrastructure
Orbiotech

Attachments: forecast-q3-q4.csv (referenced)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@orbiotech.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — capacity uplift request

Hi Elena — thanks for the detail and the forecast. Great to hear the product is scaling with you. Short answer: we can do a temporary price hold and structure prorated credits for the mid-cycle commit increase. Longer answer & options below.

Options we typically offer (pick 1 or combine):
1) 6-month price hold on current per-token rate conditioned on a 12-month renewal with a 2x committed band. Wed apply a small uplift on the on-demand burst rate outside the commit band.
2) Immediate 2x commit effective on sign, with a 3-month credit to offset the unused portion of the month in which the commit starts (we calculate prorations based on calendar days).
3) 3-month onboarding credit (one-time) to help cover early experiment costs + MOP for burst onboarding delivered by Solutions Engineering.
4) Modest multi-quarter discount (3-8%) if you lock a 24-month term for the higher band — otherwise the standard 12-month renewal applies.

What I need from you: an executable commit schedule (prefer two lines: base commit and uplift), and confirmation on whether youre open to a 24-month lock for a deeper discount. Ill loop in Ben (pricing) and Vanessa (contract) to get final language and the prorate calc. Im attaching a proposed commit schedule and a draft MOP.

Next step: Can we do a 30-min call tomorrow to align on the exact numbers? If so Ill send a calendar invite.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-commit-schedule.xlsx, orbiotech_mop_v3.pdf

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal conversation — pricing ask from Orbiotech (OD-8421)

Ben / Vanessa / Priyom — forwarding Elenas ask and my initial options. Key points for approval:
- Price hold: 6 months on current per-token pricing if they sign a 12-month renewal for 2x commit (were effectively guaranteeing price while they migrate).
- Proration: 3-month credit applied pro-rata for the month the uplift is activated; finance needs to confirm exact formula.
- Discount uplift for 24-month lock: 3-8% sliding scale depending on commit level.
- Onboarding credit: one-time $15k credit for SE time & experiments.

Im proposing the following concrete offer we can send to Elena if approved:
- 12-month renewal starting 2027-07-01
- 2x committed band added immediately on sign (billing starts 2027-07-01); apply 3-month prorated credit to cover overlap from 2027-07-01 to 2027-09-30
- 6-month price hold on existing per-token rate (through 2028-01-01)
- $15k onboarding credit and delivery of the MOP within 10 business days after signature

Can finance confirm the prorate calculation and legal confirm we can do a 6-month price hold w/out additional waiver? If yes Ill send the formal amendment + DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal conversation — pricing ask from Orbiotech (OD-8421)

Karthik — looks good in principle. Finance will sign off on the 3-month prorated credit as long as the calculation is: (daily commit value * unused days) capped at the credit amount equal to three full months of the uplifted commit tier. Priyom, please validate the exact calculation and confirm any GL impacts.

I support the 6-month price hold for a 12-month renewal at 2x commit. For the 24-month lock, limit discount to max 6% to protect cross-customer parity.

Vanessa, legal note: we need an explicit clause that the price hold applies only to per-token rates for the committed band and excludes 3rd-party infra pass-throughs. Also need Exec approval for any SLA exception on burst guarantees.

If PR approves, Karthik you can send the amendment. Ill ok the one-time $15k onboarding credit.

— Ben
VP, Revenue Operations

On 2027-05-05 13:00, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Forwarding to Finance Ops to get the prorate formula confirmed and to schedule the GL entries.
> Attachments: proposed-commit-schedule.xlsx

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@orbiotech.com>, Procurement Team <procure@orbiotech.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Final offer & next steps — Orbiotech renewal (OD-8421)

Hi Elena — thanks for the call earlier today. Confirming the offer we agreed to and next steps:

Agreed commercial terms:
- 12-month renewal term, effective 2027-07-01.
- Add 2x committed band on sign. Billing for the new commit starts 2027-07-01.
- Apply a 3-month prorated credit equal to the unused portion of the month-by-month uplift (calculated daily) capped at three full months of the uplift value. (Finance confirmed formula; see attached proposed-commit-schedule.xlsx)
- 6-month price hold on per-token rates for committed band (through 2028-01-01). Price hold excludes third-party infra pass-throughs.
- One-time $15,000 onboarding credit to be applied against first invoice after sign; Redwood SE will deliver the MOP within 10 business days of signature.

Next steps:
1) Ill upload the amendment to DocuSign and share the link within the hour: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123456
2) Please route to Procurement for signature (Procurement <procure@orbiotech.com>).
3) Once executed, Redwood will schedule the MOP kickoff and SE onboarding session.

Attachments: proposed-commit-schedule.xlsx, orbiotech_mop_v3.pdf

Thanks again — looking forward to continuing the partnership.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
